newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-UNITED INTERESTED IN BRAZIL'S CELIO SILVA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-UNITED INTERESTED IN BRAZIL'S CELIO SILVA.

text.p: English champions Manchester United are poised to sign an experienced international to boost their defence before next month's start to the new season, British newspapers reported on Sunday.
United manager Alex Ferguson is believed to be interested in bringing Brazilian international defender Celio Silva to the club.
"We have asked about Silva and we are hoping to get him over to England in the next few days to have a chat," Ferguson was quoted as saying in the Mail on Sunday.
In addition to his defensive abilities, the 29-year-old Silva, who plays for Brazilian team Corinthians, has a reputation for having one of the most powerful shots in the game.
It is well known that Ferguson is keen to buy an experienced defender and recently tried to bring Bayern Munich's German international Markus Babbel to Old Trafford.

The English champions said earlier this week that they expected to clinch another major signing before the start of the season after they bought England striker Teddy Sheringham from Tottenham last month as a replacement for retired Frenchman Eric Cantona.

Some newspapers also speculated on Sunday that Barcelona's experienced international Miguel Angel Nadal would be joining United although it is believed that the club's target is more likely to be Silva.
